BeforeStage.php:41-47 returns only Deny or HookError; BeforeResult has Continue/Deny only. AfterStage.php:34-36 logs and does not replace the decision. checklist.dimension: PolicyOnly reads no assignment state; policy true cannot replace grants
checklist.evidence: PrepareStage.php:131-133 opens ReadAttempt only for Grants. PolicyDecider.php:80-90 denies false/null Policy and Grants false; a bool true or an unqualified allow Response does not Allow. AuthorityStage.php:51-89 qualifies only Grants, then membership, then policy veto, then NotGranted. CRM AuthorityModesTest R61 recorded zero SQL on a connection that aborts every statement and a CodeStateToken; R62/R63 deny policy-true and superadmin substitutes for a missing grant or a PolicyOnly veto.

checklist.dimension: Scope, exact expiry, conditions and role filters AND per witness; contributions OR
checklist.evidence: Grant.php:93-96 and RoleContribution.php:59-62 treat expiresAt == now as expired. AuthorityStage.php:142-248 skips a witness on expiry, scope, eligibility or any false condition, and sets qualified only after that witness passes; a condition or eligibility throwable denies the decision. ScopeEligibility.php:61-87 AND-combines matching role filters, then the external adapter. forContribution keeps that grant and role. CRM R11/R13/R14 use literal DecisionReason expectations; mutations.json shows AND-to-OR and seller-filter removal fail those tests.

checklist.dimension: Four scope policies, resource/tenant owner, global ordinary, invalid refs
checklist.evidence: EvaluationFrame.php:69-91: isolated or global context queries only the selected scope; inherit/required add tenant-wide; allowGlobalRoles also queries the global tenant. BoundaryStage.php:48-118 and 130-157 deny TenantRequired, TenantMismatch, AssignmentScopeMismatch, ResourceScopeMissing, AssignmentScopeRequired and AssignmentScopeNotAccepted, including an explicit tenant/context that disagrees with the resource owner. AuthorityStage.php:150-154 drops a non-matching tenant unless the role class is allowlisted. ScopePropertiesTest P4 covers the 12-cell table; P13 covers foreign and ordinary global grants.

checklist.dimension: Superadmin only in Grants, after witness qualification, without implicit exemptions
checklist.evidence: qualify() is Grants-only. Superadmin is set at AuthorityStage.php:227-238 only after expiry, role identity, scope, eligibility and conditions. MembershipRestriction.php:64-66 returns exemptsSuperAdmin false and AuthorityStage.php:60-66 always applies it. RestrictionStage.php:75-78 skips a restriction only when that restriction exempts. Owner and common eligibility run in BoundaryStage before authority. isSuperAdmin uses the same qualify path and is not an access decision. SuperAdminTest and CRM R17 passed in V1.
